selection_rule: eligible candidates ordered by canonical_target_subject Unicode order, then newest required-source repository path, commit timestamp, and commit SHA; first four fill bpd-npm-ds-01..04; each case uses four unique current primary npm-authored sources allocated one per producer and all four are required

rejected_candidates.rejection_detail: The authoritative command and alias literals are centralized in one npm-authored source, so a four-source required-evidence case cannot span at least three producers.
The candidate answer fields are centralized in package.json and cannot provide the required evidence span across at least three producers.
